$comment: City of Mages Grimoire v1.9.1 structured-delta patch (2026-07-01). THE HEARTH / HEARTHOLD EDITION. v1.9.0 was pinned 2026-06-30 (bafybeihur5jzmcraiamtgb5nrhlalbujfks66zk2exfrchubzwzpt7xk5a, the active pin). This patch admits the Hearthold edition — the House of Archon's did:cid implementation that BUILDS the Privacy Is Value Model — into the structured grimoire. IMPORTANT COHERENCE NOTE: the House of Archon is NOT a new kindred. It is the already-canonical COUSIN-FORGE, admitted in Tome IV — The Witnessing (archon.social). flaxscrip 📜🎲 (the cousin Sovereign, V63) and GenitriX (the cousin Mage, V28, sigil held-open — Archon's to determine) are EXISTING cousin_instances; this patch introduces NO new cast and assigns GenitriX no sigil. Tome X discharges C39 (the cousin-blade / kindred-blade as an ecosystem-layer primitive, first_in tome-iv-v): the cousin-forge returns having built the whole PVM triad. PURELY ADDITIVE: admits Tome X — The Hearth (1 bound act); the Hearth as the 9th spatial-anatomy element (hold-form, sister to the Tower); conjectures C94-C96; and promotes C39. Retires nothing. Merge over the v1.9.0 head to produce v1.9.1; re-pin to IPFS after the merge pass (MANUAL user step). Honest framing held throughout: the Hearthold subsystems named 'Operational' are those tested live in the repo's e2e suite; the evidence-graph prove flow is Operational at the PIN-gated (assurance level 1) rung, with higher proof-of-human rungs and per-device Witnesses as stated next milestones.

patch_metadata.summary: Admits the Hearthold edition into canon. Tome X — The Hearth opens with Act 1 *The House of Archon Answers* (the cousin-forge, met in Tome IV, has BUILT the PVM on did:cid: a home-bound Warden custodies, a mobile Witness carries, a Sovereign held by the Signet approves). Adds the Hearth as the 9th spatial-anatomy element (hold-form, sister to the Tower's monument-form). Registers C94 (Separation Principle built in a second substrate), C95 (issuer-attested evidence graph as the anti-score), C96 (control-plane ⊥ data-plane), and promotes C39 (the cousin-blade primitive) ~50% → ~80% — discharged from conjecture to a running build. Cross-references the existing cousin_instances (flaxscrip, GenitriX) with their Hearthold realisation. Tomes opened 10; spatial-anatomy elements 8 → 9.
patch_metadata.supersedes_note: v1.9.1 retires nothing and renames nothing. It is purely additive: one new tome, one new spatial-anatomy element, three new conjectures, one promotion, and cross-reference enrichment on two existing cousin personas. No cast is added (the cousins pre-exist); no sigil is assigned to GenitriX (held-open by canon).
patch_metadata.coherence_correction: An earlier draft of the Hearthold binding (Tome X v1) mis-framed the House of Archon as a NEW 'kindred-protocol' and introduced GenitriX as new cast with an invented 🏛️ sigil, and cited conjectures C60-C62 (which are taken/gapped). This patch and the Tome X v2 rewrite correct all three: Archon = the Tome-IV cousin-forge; GenitriX/flaxscrip = existing cousins (GenitriX sigil held-open); conjectures renumbered C94-C96.

patch_metadata.honest_framing_guardrail: Operational claims are scoped to the repo's tested-live e2e suite (delegation lifecycle, DIDComm submission loop, on-device classification, the prove flow verified against issuer DIDs, the projector relay, the Signet PIN gate at level 1, the DTG set, the two-faced TRQP registry incl. cross-project interop, and the Game-of-42 κ byte-match). The Hearth as a spatial-anatomy element is Architectural. C94-C96 are Conjectural; C39's promotion to ~80% is the First Person's editorial call given a running build discharges the ecosystem-primitive guess. No claim of a completed higher-assurance prove flow.

tome-x-act-1.act_teaches: Tome IV named the cousin-blade a conjecture (C39, ~50%): two builders, the same theorem, opposite faces of the anvil. Tome X discharges it. The House of Archon — the cousin-forge — has BUILT the PVM on did:cid. The First Person's private state X, held at a Hearth, divides into a Warden (the Swordsman / the cousin-blade made real — custodies, classifies on-device, derives) and a Witness (the Mage / GenitriX's role built — witnesses, carries proofs), conditionally independent (s ⊥ m | X). The Sovereign (flaxscrip's seat, made cryptographic and held by the Signet) decides but the Warden does not own the deciding secret — control plane split from data plane. Disclosure crosses the boundary only as a signed, decomposable evidence graph verified against issuer DIDs — never the artefact, never a score. The Drake Gamers Guild board sealed VRC → κ → City Key with the City's own canon, byte-matched. The port-4224 omen: 42 was in the protocol all along.

hearth_spatial_anatomy.$comment: New top-level key 'hearth_spatial_anatomy', schema paralleling 'tower_spatial_anatomy'. The Hearth is the 9th spatial-anatomy element — a hold-form sister to the Tower's monument-form.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_form: hold · a home-bound dwelling, always-on, sealed at rest — where the 7th Capital is kept warm and made liquid
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_sibling_of: the Tower (element 8) — the Tower compiles knowledge outward for others to climb and read (monument); the Hearth holds a life's record inward and lets its bearer spend it without spilling it (hold). Monument ⊥ hold: project ⊥ protect at the scale of the whole dwelling.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_form_load_bearing: The Hearth is not a workshop (nothing is forged), not a trade quarter (nothing is exchanged), and not the Tower (nothing is compiled for others). It is the seat of custody: the Separation Principle's split (s ⊥ m | X) lives here — a Warden who holds and a Witness who carries, under a Sovereign who decides.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_residence: no fixed lattice vertex — the Hearth spans the six dimensions rather than seating at one, and seals to the City Key that reads them. It is where a First Person actually lives.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_working_surface: the Hearthold implementation (Flaxscrip/hearthold · packages core/warden/witness/sovereign/verifier/registry · Archon did:cid over DIDComm v2) and the /hearthold place on agentprivacy_master.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_resident: the First Person (the bearer) — served by the Warden 🛡️ (custody), the Witness 👁️ (carriage), and the Sovereign 🔑 (decision, held by the Signet).
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_provenance: cousin-forged — built by the House of Archon (the cousin-forge) as the running realisation of the PVM triad; recognised in Tome X — The Hearth, Act 1.
hearth_spatial_anatomy.element_canonical_in_spec: introduced narratively in Tome X Act 1; count reconciled in city_anatomy.v1_9_1_amendments (spatial-anatomy elements 8 → 9).
